text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a customer invoice preview spike for tenant=acme-corp after the fallback routing rollout at 08:12UTC. Preview shows ~2x token counts for some routes. Can someone look?
ash: :eyes: which preview? any repro steps?
maria: the console preview (Invoices > Preview). I grabbed the windowed events for 08:00-08:15 UTC. Logs show duplicate billing events for the same request_id but different route_id. snippet below.
maria: ```
2026-01-18T08:13:02Z INFO request_id=01GkXf.. route_id=route-v2 fallback_from=route-v1 tokens=120
2026-01-18T08:13:02Z INFO request_id=01GkXf.. route_id=route-v1 tokens=120
```
lee: billing-bot flagged it too earlier: "alert: invoice-preview-delta > 20% for tenant acme-corp"
billing-bot: alert generated at 2026-01-18T08:20:00Z - signature mismatch in route attribution detected
sam: hmm looks like when fallback triggers we rewrite route_id but fail to keep original_request_id canonical. The metering pipeline dedupe key is (route_id, request_id) — i think fallback creates a second event with the same request_id but a different route_id and so it becomes double-counted.
devon: iirc, the pipeline accepts (client_request_id || generated_request_id) as the dedupe key, and route normalization happens upstream in the edge. When we did the fallback change we started injecting route_alias header which then replaced route_id in event enrichment.
ash: so root cause = enrichment ordering + dedupe key uses route_id. sgtm.
maria: what's the minimal fix?
sam: short term: change dedupe key to ignore route_id (use original_request_id + tenant + minute-window). That will dedupe these duplicates for preview and invoices. Medium term: we should guarantee original_request_id propagation through all enrichers and add an event.sequence counter to break ties.
devon: agreeing. Also need to update console to surface route_alias vs route_id so operators can tell whether fallback happened. Right now preview only shows final route which is confusing.
lee: action items: 1) patch metering-consumer to use dedupe key=(original_request_id, tenant, billing_window) 2) add migration/backfill to collapse duplicate events in preview state 3) console change to show fallback flag 4) add regression test to routing simulator
maria: estimate for (1) — 2-3 hours + canary. (2) backfill script maybe 4-6 hours depending on query perf. (3) small console UI tweak, 1 day. (4) test + release gating 1 day.
nash: can we canary (1) on preview pipeline only so invoices remain untouched until validated?
sam: yes — we can route 5% of preview traffic to the dedupe-change via feature-flag in the consumer. no impact to live invoices if we keep primary path unchanged.
devon: note: we must be careful — deduping on original_request_id only is safe if original_request_id is guaranteed unique per logical request. There are a few clients (legacy mobile SDK) that don't set it — fallback uses generated ids. We should prefer a composite (tenant, timestamp_ms, client_hash) as fallback.
maria: i'll open a quick RFC PR with proposed dedupe key and rollout plan. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/patches/3284
lee: i'll start a backfill ticket and schedule a low-priority job to run after the patch passes canary. Also add a dashboard card to show "duplicate events per tenant" so we can monitor.
billing-bot: deploy-plan: canary 5% preview -> monitor duplicate-rate and invoice-delta metric. rollback if duplicate-rate decreases < 5% or any invoice-delta > 1%.
sam: for traceability, let's add an event header original_request_id in the Kafka message and a debug flag to keep raw-enrichment payloads for 1h in dev to validate.
maria: any objections?
ash: none, go for the canary. pls post the patch and tag me.
devon: small follow-up: we should also look at token rounding mismatch — the logs show tokens=120 in both events; but preview summation uses float rounding per-op. Might cause small deltas even after dedupe. Recommend consistent integer token accounting as canonical.
maria: noted, adding integer-token field to the ticket.
lee: putting owners: sam (metering-consumer), devon (edge/enricher), maria (console + coordination).
maria: will update this thread with PR + canary IDs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
